newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler reaches tentative engine plant pact.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler reaches tentative engine plant pact.

text.p: Chrysler Corp. said Wednesday it reached a tentative agreement to end a month-long strike at its Mound Road Engine plant in Detroit.

Details of the pact were not immediately available. The agreement was reached early Wednesday afternoon after round-the-clock bargaining that began late Tuesday afternoon. Workers are expected to vote on the agreement on Friday, a Chrysler spokesman said.
The strike by 1,856 members of United Auto Workers union Local 51 began when they walked off the job shortly before midnight April 9.

Chrysler was forced to suspend operations at its pickup truck and sport utility vehicle plants in North America, idling 18,916 workers. Analysts estimate the strike has cost the nation's No. 3 automaker more than $300 million in lost profits.
